"''Two Jedi have landed in the main hangar bay. We're tracking them.|General Grievous and Lushros Dofine during the Battle of Coruscant|audio=WhatsTheSituation-ROTS.flac|}} '''Lushros Dofine''' was a [[Neimoidian]] [[Gender|male]] who served as the [[captain]] of the [[Providence-class Dreadnought|''Providence''-class Dreadnought]] ''[[Invisible Hand]]'' during the [[Battle of Coruscant]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|Magnetize! Magnetize!|The captain ordering the droids on his ship to magnetize.|}} [[File:LushrosDofineFire-ROTS.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The captain on the bridge of the ''Invisible Hand''.]] [[Captain]] Lushros Dofine{{EncyclopediaCite|Republic and Separatist Ships (1)}} {{C|English version only}} and other members of the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] crew originally served the [[Trade Federation]] onboard the ''Invisible Hand'' when the [[dreadnought]] was owned by [[Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray]]. After [[General]] [[Grievous]] demanded command of the ship, the bridge crew, including Dofine, were allowed to stay, though they were now assisted by [[B1-series battle droid|droids]]. Under Grievous's command, the ''Invisible Hand'' served as the [[flagship]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|Confederacy navy]] and fought in many battles during the [[Clone Wars]]. In [[19 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' the captain was still in command of the ''Invisible Hand'' during the [[Battle of Coruscant]]. After Grievous kidnapped the head of the [[Galactic Republic]], [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]], Jedi Knight [[Anakin Skywalker]] and Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] boarded the ship to rescue him. Grievous entered the bridge and requested a status update from the caption, who informed Grievous they were tracking the Jedi as the two made their way down the halls. As a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Guarlara (Venator-class)|Guarlara]]'' came alongside the ''Invisible Hand'', Dofine ordered all batteries to open fire on the Republic ship. As the two ships shot at each other, the artificial gravity of the ''Invisible Hand'' was damaged and the ship began falling towards [[Coruscant]]. As the ship fell, Dofine ordered the battle droids to magnetize in order to prevent them from flying around. The ''Invisible Hand'' eventually stopped falling, leveling itself out, and repaired its artificial gravity. [[File:TheBridgeCrewEscapes.png|thumb|right|270px|The captain and the rest of the bridge crew escaping.]] When Kenobi and Skywalker rescued Palpatine, the three of them were trapped in a [[ray shield]] and, along with their astromech droid [[R2-D2]], were brought before Grievous on the bridge. The captain watched as Grievous and the Jedi exchanged insults, before R2-D2 broke the handcuffs restricting Skywalker's arms, who in turn freed Kenobi. Grievous ordered his [[IG-100 MagnaGuard|MagnaGuards]] to kill the Jedi, but they were able to easily defeat them. As the two confronted Grievous, the General broke a front window with an [[electrostaff]], letting himself be sucked out of it to escape. As the window's safety shutter covered broken [[transparisteel]], the captain, along with other Neimoidian crew members fled the bridge to the [[escape pod]]s. ==Behind the scenes== Lushros Dofine first appeared as an unnamed character in the opening scenes of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. Within the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity the character was first identified in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]].{{DB|character|lushrosdofine|Dofine, Lushros}} ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars: The Prequel Trilogy – A Graphic Novel]]'' *{{Film|III}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{HelmetCollectionCite|8|Highlights of the Saga}} *''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' {{Po}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|R2-D2}} {{Po}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Republic and Separatist Ships (1)}} {{1stID|Lushros Dofine}} {{C|English version only}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Lushros Dofine |ka=ლაშროს დოფინი }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Dofine, Lushros}} [[Category:Captains]] [[Category:Confederacy of Independent Systems navy officers]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Neimoidians]] [[Category:Trade Federation military members]]
